name: Passeport Talent — Carte bleue européenne

requirements.blocker_text: This requires an employment contract (CDI, or CDD of at least 6 months) with an employer established in France.
This requires a higher-education qualification (minimum Bac+3), or 5+ years of recognised equivalent professional experience.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain formal recognition of your qualification if issued outside the EU.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a gross annual salary of at least €59,373 (2026 figure — 1.5x the fixed talent reference salary).
requirements.fix_path: Negotiate a higher salary meeting the Blue Card threshold.

evidence_required.document: Employment contract meeting the Blue Card salary threshold
Degree certificate or documented equivalent professional experience

sources.title: Légifrance — CESEDA Art. L421-11 (carte bleue européenne)

notes: Threshold confirmed as exactly 1.5x the fixed talent_salarie_qualifie reference — a clean formula relationship between two France routes, similar in spirit to how Spain's Blue Card and PAC categories share an identical figure. EU mobility after 18 months of residence — a real advantage over the standard Passeport Talent Salarié Qualifié route, which doesn't carry the same EU-portability rights, worth surfacing prominently in a comparison view. Formally a Passeport Talent sub-category (not a fully standalone route in French law) but modeled as its own file here for consistency with how every other country in this dataset treats Blue Card as its own route, matching the schema's practice elsewhere.
